% pdfTeX's driver option given to the class and to changebar with
% \PassOptionsToPackage, then changebar loaded again with the option,
% which is no clash. The text is the same as without the option.
\documentclass[pdftex]{article}
\PassOptionsToPackage{pdftex}{changebar}
\usepackage{changebar}
\RequirePackage[pdftex]{changebar}
\begin{document}
Before the bar. \cbstart Inside the class's bar.\cbend{} After the bar.
\end{document}
